scenes.a: Greet the morning. This is The Morning Altar, and this is the hour we keep.

The Morning Altar reads it again, slowly: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications. Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

scenes.a: Lord, The Morning Altar comes to You about morning mercy.

scenes.a: Where morning mercy has gone wrong in our lives, stand in for us.

captions: Greet the morning. This is The Morning Altar, and this is the hour we keep.

The Morning Altar reads it again, slowly: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications. Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
Lord, The Morning Altar comes to You about morning mercy.
What this verse promises is what The Morning Altar is asking for on this channel.

Take what The Morning Altar just prayed into the rest of your day.
